template.title: Music Bingo at Aura
template.shortDescription: Thursday Music Bingo in The Vista with Four Dogs Entertainment.
template.description: Meet your people in The Vista for a Thursday night of familiar songs and Music Bingo with Four Dogs Entertainment at Aura Kitchen & Bar. The four confirmed trial dates are October 22, October 29, November 5, and November 12.
template.instructions: Contact Aura for seating, admission, and participation requirements. Music Bingo runs from 7:30 to 9:30 PM.

changes.title: 2000s vs. 2010s Music Bingo at Aura
changes.description: Settle the throwback debate with your people. Four Dogs brings 2000s vs. 2010s Music Bingo to Aura Kitchen & Bar in The Vista. Listen for familiar hits and follow along with the host for a Thursday night of music and friendly competition.
